title: BE rejects editing one of the 3 uneditable system roles (Admin/Office/Time Clock User flagged uneditable post-Owner-removal)
steps:
1. PATCH/PUT the system-office role with a modified bundle list.
2. Inspect response.
3. Repeat for system-timeclock.
4. Repeat for system-owner and system-admin (these may or may not be uneditable — depends on resolution of tech-plan vs screenshot conflict).
expected: system-office and system-timeclock edit attempts → 403 (or 400). system-owner and system-admin: behavior tracks current product decision — if uneditable, also 403/400; if editable, 200 with modifications applied.
